framework.name: NIST SP 800-53
framework.disclaimer: CSW evidence status, NOT a compliance attestation. Only the subset of controls CSW can technically evidence is mapped.

controls.intent: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access at the workload.
Enforce approved authorizations controlling information flow between segments.
controls.note: CSW evidences enforcement coverage; flow-rule correctness needs human review.

controls.intent: Authorize and control internal system connections via segmentation.
Restrict workloads to only required network reachability (least functionality).
controls.note: Partial: CSW restricts network reachability, not installed software/services.

controls.intent: Maintain an inventory of system components (agent-reported).
Monitor and control communications at internal/external boundaries.
Deny network traffic by default; allow only by explicit exception.
Isolate system components into separate segments by function.
A segmentation architecture is defined (scopes exist).
Log network access events (flow telemetry as audit records).
controls.note: Evidences network-flow logging, not host/application audit logs.

controls.intent: Generate audit records for network communications.
Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators (continuous flow visibility).
Maintain ongoing situational awareness via deployed monitoring agents.
Physical access controls to facilities and equipment.
Personnel screening prior to authorizing access.
System backup of user- and system-level information.
System security and privacy plans are developed and maintained.
